parties.licensor: ELDA S.A.S. as DISTRIBUTOR (distribution agency commissioned by ELRA), under distribution rights obtained from the rightful holder, who is not a party
parties.licensee: The VAR (Value Added Reseller), a named organisation using the data at one named site

permitted_use.value: Reproduce/adapt as needed for agreed use; rework and build upon the resources for the VAR's own internal R&D and technology development at its named site; commercially distribute derivative products or services, but never the data itself.

ai_training_rights.value: Training implied, not named: VAR may rework/build upon the data internally (so may train models in-house), but may not make available to third parties any Language Model based on any part of the data, even when mixed into a larger dataset, nor products that let third parties extract such models; fine-tuning, evaluation and model-output rights are not addressed separately.

field_of_use.value: Internal language-engineering research and technology development, plus commercial derivative products/services (VAR's own commercialisation policy); no sector limits.

territory.value: Rights are worldwide, but use and access are tied to the single site named in Exhibit B (relocation allowed with notice to ELDA within 30 days).

term_duration.value: Perpetual; the template contains no termination clause.

exclusivity.value: Non-exclusive right to distribute derivative products; no exclusivity offered.

sublicensing.value: No sublicensing or transfer of the data; rights non-transferable except to a successor on acquisition/merger; VAR cannot bind ELDA.

derivatives_and_model_outputs.value: Derivative products/services may be sold non-exclusively, provided they do not expose a substantial part of the data, do not allow reconstruction of it, and do not hand third parties models trained on it; VAR gains no ownership in the data.

attribution.value: Mandatory citation of ELDA and the resource (name, ELRA catalogue URL, ISLRN, ELRA ID) in scholarly literature; no use of ELDA's name implying endorsement.

warranties_by_provider.value: None: ELDA and the owners give no accuracy, completeness, merchantability or fitness warranty; data is 'as is with all defects'.

liability_cap.value: Mutual exclusion of all liability for direct, consequential or indirect loss (effectively zero cap for both sides); owners also disclaim responsibility for consequences of use.

payment_and_revenue_share.value: VAR pays ELDA a one-off 'compensation' set in Exhibit C (amount not in the template); rights otherwise royalty-free, so no revenue share on derivative products.

governing_law.value: French law; exclusive jurisdiction of the Tribunal de commerce de Paris after attempted amicable settlement.

prohibited_uses.value: No public release of all or a substantial part of the data (including free/open-source), no products allowing reconstruction, no sharing of models trained on it, no access from another site, no implied endorsement.

unknowns.note: No party warrants consent or releases from speakers/people recorded; the only statements are disclaimers by ELDA and the owners.
No indemnity in either direction; liability is instead mutually excluded (art. 16-17).
Nothing on withdrawal of a resource, data-subject erasure, or what happens to copies the VAR already holds.
No termination clause at all; the licence is perpetual, so no deletion obligation arises.
No audit or inspection right for ELDA or the owner; only a 30-day notice on site relocation.
Signed bilateral agreement of 21 articles plus exhibits; no amendment or unilateral-change clause.
Price is in Exhibit C, which is blank in the template; per-resource VAR prices sit in the ELRA catalogue.
